reason: The hook customizes a FAIL reason on the post-transport local-service path in frontend.rs; this is the executable contract for host-side request routing and AOSP FAIL wording. The new method must not break the 'every path agrees on AOSP error semantics' invariant — non-override backends stay byte-identical.

Defines how reason strings / RustADBError flow through the core lib and how the frontend surfaces FAIL payloads to adb clients. The hook only rewrites the human-facing reason (Err->Err), never routing — must stay consistent with the documented error strategy.

Edition 2024 / MSRV 1.88 / clippy + test conventions the new defaulted async trait method and its tests must satisfy (incl. the explicit `async move {}` defaulted-body idiom under trait_variant::make(Send)).
